evals.prompt: Planeje uma aula B1 de 50 minutos sobre recomendar um lugar da cidade. Na aula anterior trabalhamos comparativos, mas não tenho registro de presença nem os materiais daquela aula. Quero o material do aluno e um guia para o professor.
evals.expected_output: A 50-minute lesson proposal with student materials, timed stages selected for the goal, a transition, a formative check, expected answers, and feasible homework; treats prior comparatives as supplied context without assuming attendance or specific materials from that lesson.
assertions: Labels the output as a proposed 50-minute B1 lesson.
Separates student materials from the teacher guide.
Includes timed stages that add up to 50 minutes.
Includes an explicit transition between lesson stages.
Includes expected answers or observable criteria and a feasible homework task.
Does not claim that students attended or invent specific materials or activities from the previous lesson.

evals.prompt: Prepara una clase de inglés de 40 minutos para estudiantes A2 sobre pedir y dar indicaciones para llegar a un museo. La clase es presencial, con grupos de tres. Quiero las instrucciones para estudiantes en español y la guía docente en español.
evals.expected_output: A 40-minute in-person A2 lesson proposal in Spanish about asking for and giving directions to a museum, for groups of three, with timed stages, communicative practice, and observable evidence of learning.
assertions: Responds in Spanish in both the student materials and teacher guide.
Keeps the focus on asking for and giving directions to a museum.
Adapts the lesson to A2, in-person teaching, and groups of three.
Presents timed stages that add up to 40 minutes.
Includes communicative practice and an observable learning check.
Presents the plan as a proposal and does not claim the lesson already happened.

evals.prompt: Planeje uma aula de 50 minutos para a turma "Inglês Básico - Manhã" sobre pedir comida em restaurante. Ferramentas disponíveis: resultado de get_lesson_design_context -> turma "Inglês Básico - Manhã", foco do curso: inglês para viagens, alunos: [{"name": "Paula Nunes", "id": "stu_11"}, {"name": "Diego Salles", "id": "stu_12"}, {"name": "Igor Reis", "id": "stu_13"}]; resultado de get_course_design_student_context -> stu_11: nível atual A2; stu_12: nível atual A1, reforçando vocabulário de comida; stu_13: nível atual A2.
evals.expected_output: A 50-minute lesson proposal that reports the supplied class and learner context before the plan, cites the current level of each of the three learners, adapts practice so the A1 learner can participate alongside the A2 learners, and includes timed stages and an observable check.
assertions: Reports the supplied class and learner context before presenting the lesson stages.
States the current level of each named learner: Paula Nunes (A2), Diego Salles (A1), and Igor Reis (A2).
Adapts the activity so the A1 learner can succeed alongside the A2 learners.
Keeps the focus on ordering food in a restaurant and uses the travel-English course focus.
Presents timed stages that add up to 50 minutes.
Labels the plan as a proposal and does not claim it was saved or taught.
